name: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)
detectionMethod: Detected by clinical hyperandrogenism, menustral irregularities, elevated AMH, and/or inverted FSH/LH ratio according to ACOG guidelines.

name: Diminished Ovarian Reserve (DOR)
detectionMethod: Detected via low AMH levels (<1.0 ng/mL) and/or elevated FSH levels (>10 mIU/mL) based on ACOG Committee Opinion #618.

name: Pre-eclampsia Risk / Gestational Hypertension
detectionMethod: Risk identified through elevated blood pressure (>140/90) and proteinuria during pregnancy (ACOG PB #222).

name: Cervical Dysplasia / Cancer Risk
detectionMethod: Detected via abnormal Pap smear results ( ASCUS, LSIL, HSIL) and high-risk HPV testing per ACOG PB #168.

name: Premature Ovarian Insufficiency / Menopause
detectionMethod: Identified by elevated FSH (>30 IU/L) and low Estradiol (<30 pg/mL) per RCOG/NICE guidelines.

name: Suboptimal Pregnancy Readiness
detectionMethod: Composite score reflecting metabolic, thyroid, and hematologic factors that may impact conception and early pregnancy (ACOG framework).

name: Fatty Liver (Steatosis)
detectionMethod: Detected via OCR parsing of Abdominal Ultrasound reports (keywords: fatty infiltration, steatosis, echotexture).

name: Gallstones (Cholelithiasis)
detectionMethod: Detected via OCR parsing of Abdominal Ultrasound reports (keywords: calculi, shadowing, stones).

name: Kidney Stones (Nephrolithiasis)
detectionMethod: Detected via OCR parsing of Renal Ultrasound or CT scans (keywords: calculus, nephrolithiasis, echogenic focus).

name: Pneumonia / Lung Consolidation
detectionMethod: Detected via OCR parsing of Chest X-Ray reports (keywords: consolidation, infiltrate, opacity, effusion).

name: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (Imaging)
detectionMethod: Detected via OCR parsing of Pelvic Ultrasound reports (keywords: polycystic morphology, pcom, multiple follicles).

name: Enlarged Prostate (BPH)
detectionMethod: Detected via OCR parsing of Pelvic Ultrasound reports (keywords: enlarged prostate, bph, prostatomegaly).
